title: Fix a Failing Readiness Probe
prompt:
The Pod of Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-ts-ready` stays `Running` but never becomes `Ready`: its readiness probe requests a path that the server answers with 404.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Fix the `readinessProbe` of Deployment `web` so its Pod becomes `Ready`.
2. Keep the container image `nginx:1.27-alpine` unchanged.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-ts-ready
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 80

checks.description: Pod of Deployment `web` is Running and Ready
checks.failure_hint: The probe path returns 404 — point it at a path nginx serves (e.g. /).
Do not change the image; fix only the readiness probe.

checks.description: Deployment reports at least 1 available replica
checks.failure_hint: No replica is available until the readiness probe succeeds.

reference_solution:
Point the readiness probe at a served path.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-ts-ready patch deployment web --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe/httpGet/path","value":"/"}]'
```
hints: Run `k -n cka-ts-ready describe pod` to observe failing readiness probe HTTP responses and endpoints status.
Inspect `readinessProbe.httpGet.path` in Deployment `web` and point it to a path nginx serves (`/`).
